name: Rat A Tat Cat
summary: A memory card game where players hide four cards, swap for lower values, and knock when they think they have the lowest total.
rules_text: Each player gets 4 face-down cards in a row. Players secretly look once at their two outer cards. On your turn draw the top discard and you must swap it for one of your face-down cards, or draw the top of the deck and you may swap it or discard it. Power cards drawn from the deck have effects instead of points: Peek lets you look at one of your cards, Swap lets you blindly exchange one of your cards with another player's, Draw 2 lets you draw up to two more cards with similar choices. Power cards dealt at start have no power and must be replaced at showdown. When you believe you are lowest, knock at end of your turn to trigger one final turn for each opponent, then all reveal, replace any remaining Power cards with draw pile cards, sum points lowest wins round. Total scores accumulate over rounds.
rating_reason: Memory card game with hidden hands and bluffing, fits engine
